supporting_article_titles: Looking beyond peak: Industry coalition floats new approach to measuring grid utilization
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Grid planning is moving from a peak-only view toward standardized utilization metrics that expose off-peak latent capacity and where flexible loads can be accommodated.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: interval load data → utilization baseline → flexible-load scenario → capacity/investment decision
raw_opportunities.target_customer: large-load developers, industrial energy managers, EV charging/data-center project teams and energy consultants
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: screen sites and load-shifting scenarios before expensive interconnection or infrastructure studies
raw_opportunities.current_friction: peak demand alone can hide usable off-peak capacity, leaving early-stage teams without a simple scenario ledger for utilization and flexible-load assumptions
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: upload interval-load/utility data, calculate standardized utilization metrics, model flexible-load windows, compare site scenarios, and export an evidence-backed pre-feasibility report
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A grid-utilization pre-feasibility workspace for large-load projects that turns interval data into flexible-capacity and site-comparison scenarios.
raw_opportunities.why_now: An industry coalition is proposing common utilization measurements as new flexibility tools make off-peak capacity operationally useful.

evidence_notes.source_fact: Utility Dive describes peak and utilization reporting as complementary benchmarks for planning and identifying where flexibility or new infrastructure creates value.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Trakya factories, warehouses and future high-load projects could use the same pre-feasibility workflow where interval consumption data is available; local existence of the exact decision workflow still requires validation.

supporting_article_titles: Trace.Space launches Trinity to tackle hardware engineering’s next bottleneck
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Hardware teams facing faster product iteration are getting software that keeps requirements, tests, variants and changes connected instead of tracking them in fragmented documents.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: customer/system requirement → engineering requirement → variant/change → test evidence → release readiness
raw_opportunities.target_customer: small and mid-size hardware manufacturers, machinery builders and industrial product teams
raw_opportunities.buyer: engineering manager, quality manager or product-development lead
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: maintain lightweight requirement-to-test traceability across variants and engineering changes without adopting a heavyweight PLM stack
raw_opportunities.current_friction: requirements, change decisions and verification evidence become fragmented as hardware variants multiply
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: structured requirement/change register, variant matrix, test-evidence links, impact view and release-readiness checklist
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight requirements-to-test traceability desk for smaller hardware manufacturers with variant and engineering-change control.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Trace.Space's Trinity launch explicitly frames connected requirements/testing/variants/changes as the next hardware-engineering bottleneck.

evidence_notes.source_fact: Tech.eu reports Trinity targets tracking requirements, testing, variants and changes as hardware products become faster and more complex.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Machinery, automotive-supplier and industrial-product teams in the Lüleburgaz–Çorlu–Çerkezköy corridor plausibly share variant/change traceability needs; local workflow evidence should be validated before assigning Lüleburgaz scope.

supporting_article_titles: Cyient DLM sees next big opportunity in AI data centers, robotics, says CEO Rajendra Velagapudi
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: AI data centers and humanoid robotics are creating new multi-component sourcing opportunities spanning power controllers, cables, connectors, cooling systems, sensors and dozens of PCBs.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: new AI/robotics program BOM → supplier capability mapping → qualification evidence → sourcing package → readiness gaps
raw_opportunities.target_customer: electronics contract manufacturers and component suppliers trying to enter AI data-center or robotics supply chains
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: translate existing manufacturing capabilities into a qualification-ready opportunity map for new AI/robotics programs
raw_opportunities.current_friction: suppliers can see market growth but must manually map their certifications, processes and component capabilities against unfamiliar program requirements
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: capability profile + target-program BOM/category matrix + evidence checklist + gap register + qualification action plan
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A supplier-readiness workspace that maps an electronics manufacturer's capabilities to AI data-center and robotics sourcing packages.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Cyient DLM says it is actively entering AI data-center and robotics supply chains, citing concrete component categories and 60–70 PCBs in humanoids.

evidence_notes.source_fact: Cyient DLM identifies power controllers, cables, connectors, cooling, PCBAs, sensors and many robot PCBs as target work packages.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Automotive/electronics suppliers in Trakya could reuse a capability-to-program qualification workflow, but the assigned evidence does not establish a Lüleburgaz electronics cluster strongly enough for local scope.

supporting_article_titles: Instagram, içerik üreticileri için yapay zeka destekli video asistanını kullanıma sundu
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Creator platforms can now combine account metrics, retention, comments, trends and audience interests conversationally to surface performance patterns, shifting value from generic creative advice toward account-specific analysis.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: multi-platform performance exports → normalized metrics → pattern/experiment analysis → next-content decision → result tracking
raw_opportunities.target_customer: creator agencies and brands managing creators across multiple social platforms
raw_opportunities.buyer: creator manager, social-media lead or agency owner
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: compare account-specific performance evidence across platforms and keep a test/decision ledger rather than relying on generic content advice
raw_opportunities.current_friction: native assistants are platform-specific while agencies often manage the same creator or brand across several channels and manually reconcile insights
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: CSV/manual metric import, normalized KPI view, hypothesis/experiment ledger, cross-platform comparison and decision history
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A cross-platform creator experiment ledger that turns exported account metrics into comparable hypotheses, decisions and outcome tracking.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Instagram's Edits assistant now uses account metrics plus comments/trends to provide personalized analysis, validating demand for analysis rather than automated creativity.

evidence_notes.source_fact: TechCrunch reports the Edits assistant combines follows, views, retention, likes, shares, comments, trends and audience interests; creators asked for analysis rather than creative work.
evidence_notes.constraint: MVP should rely on user-exported CSV/manual data rather than paid social APIs.

supporting_article_titles: Neura Robotics steigt ins Gesundheitswesen ein
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Autonomous mobile robots are moving into hospital intralogistics such as transporting empty beds, creating a recurring dispatch, exception and utilization workflow around physical automation.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: transport request → task eligibility → robot/human assignment → exception/escalation → completion/utilization log
raw_opportunities.target_customer: hospitals piloting or operating autonomous transport robots alongside human porters
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: coordinate which internal transport jobs should go to robots versus humans and document exceptions during pilots
raw_opportunities.current_friction: robot pilots add a new dispatch layer and require operational evidence before wider deployment
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: request queue, eligibility rules, robot/human assignment, exception log, turnaround metrics and pilot ROI dashboard; no robot-control integration in MVP
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A vendor-neutral hospital robot-pilot operations ledger for dispatch eligibility, exceptions and ROI evidence.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Neura's healthcare expansion includes an autonomous robot designed for hospital transport work, making mixed human/robot operations more concrete.

evidence_notes.source_fact: Corroborating coverage describes an autonomous hospital transport robot for moving empty beds.
evidence_notes.constraint: MVP is operational coordination/evidence software, not safety-critical robot control.

supporting_article_titles: Port of Oakland August volumes fall year over year as exports edge up from July
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Persistent gateway-level shifts in imports, exports, empty-container movements and vessel calls make port choice a changing operating assumption rather than a static routing preference.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: public port statistics → lane/gateway baseline → monthly deviation → shipper routing review → decision/evidence log
raw_opportunities.target_customer: small importers/exporters and forwarders that lack enterprise network-optimization software
raw_opportunities.buyer: logistics manager or forwarder account manager
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: track whether gateway traffic shifts justify a structured review of routing assumptions using public data
raw_opportunities.current_friction: smaller teams see port statistics as isolated news and do not maintain a normalized gateway-change history tied to their routing decisions
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: manual/public monthly port-stat import, normalized gateway scorecard, threshold alerts, routing-review queue and decision history
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight public-data gateway watch that turns port-volume shifts into routing-review tasks for smaller shippers and forwarders.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Oakland reported August total TEUs down 9.6% year over year, loaded cargo down 9%, imports down 15%, and fewer vessel calls while exports were relatively steadier.

evidence_notes.source_fact: FreightWaves and the Port of Oakland report 173,818 August TEUs, weaker imports/empty movements and 82 vessel calls versus 90 a year earlier.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Türkiye exporters/forwarders could apply the same public-port-stat review workflow to regional gateways if comparable data is accessible; assigned material does not justify Lüleburgaz scope.
